ValidationRule.description: Candidate portal users cannot directly edit an application after it leaves Draft. A controlled withdrawal transition remains permitted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.RTP_Candidate_Portal_User, NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Draft")), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Withdrawn"), NOT(ISBLANK(Withdrawal_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Withdrawal_Reason__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Submitted applications are locked. Use the controlled withdrawal action if you need to withdraw.
